authorization_source: User-approved remaining-failure repair plan, 2026-10-24, proven lock-order repair in section 3
original_query:
SELECT session.id::text AS session_id, session.status AS session_status,
            session.row_version, session.thread_id::text,
            thread.provider, thread.channel_account_id, thread.chat_type,
            thread.external_thread_key, thread.status AS thread_status
       FROM conversation.session AS session
       JOIN conversation.thread AS thread ON thread.id = session.thread_id
      WHERE session.id = $1::uuid
      FOR UPDATE OF session, thread
replacement_query:
WITH locked_thread AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT thread.id FROM conversation.thread AS thread
         JOIN conversation.session AS source_session ON source_session.thread_id = thread.id
        WHERE source_session.id = $1::uuid
        FOR UPDATE OF thread
       )
     SELECT session.id::text AS session_id, session.status AS session_status,
            session.row_version, session.thread_id::text,
            thread.provider, thread.channel_account_id, thread.chat_type,
            thread.external_thread_key, thread.status AS thread_status
       FROM conversation.session AS session
       JOIN conversation.thread AS thread ON thread.id = session.thread_id
       JOIN locked_thread ON locked_thread.id = thread.id
      WHERE session.id = $1::uuid
      FOR UPDATE OF session, thread
